entities.summary: Edward Dickinson was an American politician from Massachusetts. He is also known as the father of the poet Emily Dickinson; their family home in Amherst, the Emily Dickinson Museum, is a museum dedicated to her. Edward Dickinson was a legal figures from Amherst (1803, Amherst–1874-06-16). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
